title: Sam's Beans
text: Sam planted beans in a pot by the window. He watered them every morning. After ten days, two small green leaves came up. Sam showed them to his grandmother.

title: The Red Bus
text: Every day, Aditi takes the red bus to school. The bus stops at the post office. Her friend Joy gets on there. They sit together at the back.

title: Market Day
text:
On Saturday, Grandpa took Leela to the market. They bought onions, tomatoes and a big watermelon.

On the way home, it started to rain. Grandpa opened his black umbrella, and they shared it. The watermelon was so heavy that Leela had to rest twice.

title: The Science Club Trip
text: The science club meets on Tuesdays after lunch. Last week the club planned to visit the museum on Friday. But the bus was not free, so the trip moved to the following Monday. Mrs Rao asked everyone to bring a notebook and a packed lunch.

title: The Kitten
text: Priya found a little grey kitten under the stairs. It was cold and hungry. She gave it some warm milk in a blue bowl. Now the kitten sleeps on her bed.

title: The Football Match
text: Our school played a football match against Green Hill School. It was a hot day. Our team scored three goals and Green Hill scored one. Farhan scored the last goal with his head.

title: A Visit to the Zoo
text:
In the morning, Class 4 visited the zoo. First they saw the elephants having a bath. Then they watched the monkeys swing from branch to branch.

At noon, they ate lunch under a big neem tree. After lunch, a keeper showed them how he feeds the tortoises. He gave them lettuce and pieces of pumpkin.

title: The Pencil Box
text: Arun thought he had left his pencil box in the classroom. He looked under his desk and inside his bag, but it was not there. Then his sister remembered seeing it on the kitchen table that morning. It was there, next to the bread.

title: Rain
text: Dark clouds filled the sky. Maya ran to bring the clothes in from the line. She was just in time. A minute later, the rain came down hard.

title: The New Bicycle
text:
For his birthday, Raj got a green bicycle with a silver bell. At first he kept falling off.

His older sister held the back of the seat while he pedalled. After a week, she let go without telling him. Raj rode all the way to the end of the lane on his own.

title: The Library Book
text: Mina borrowed a book about volcanoes on Monday. She had to return it in two weeks. She finished it in four days and returned it early, on Friday, so that her friend could read it.

title: Our Mango Tree
text: There is a mango tree outside our house. In summer it gives us sweet mangoes. Birds build nests in its branches. On hot days, we sit in its shade.

title: A Cake for Mum
text: Ben wanted to make a cake for his mother. He mixed flour, sugar and eggs. But he forgot to turn on the oven! When he noticed, he laughed, turned it on, and waited. The cake was late, but his mother loved it.

title: Camels
text:
Camels can live in the desert for many days without water. They store fat in their humps, which their bodies can use for energy.

Camels also have long eyelashes and can close their noses. This keeps out the sand when the wind blows.

title: Walking to School
text:
Many children in our town walk to school. Walking is good exercise, and it is cheaper than taking a bus.

But the roads near the school are busy in the morning. The town council has decided to paint new crossings and to put a guard at the main gate.

title: Clean Teeth
text: Brush your teeth twice a day, in the morning and at night. Use a small amount of toothpaste. Brush for two minutes. Clean teeth stay strong and healthy.

title: The Baby Bird
text: Lalita found a baby bird on the ground. It could not fly yet. She called her father, who gently put it back in its nest. The next day, the mother bird was feeding it.

title: Honey
text:
Honey is made by bees from the nectar of flowers. They carry the nectar back to the hive and store it in wax cells.

People have eaten honey for thousands of years. It was used to sweeten food long before sugar was common, and some people still use it as a medicine for sore throats.

title: Water for the Birds
text:
Our class wanted to help the birds near our school. We put out bowls of water on the roof during the hot months.

At first, only crows came. After a week, sparrows, mynas and even a kingfisher came to drink. Now we keep a list of every bird we see.

title: Kite Day
text: In January, the sky over our city fills with kites. People fly them from rooftops. Some kites are shaped like birds. Everyone shouts when a kite is cut.

title: The Drum
text: Nikhil practised the drum every evening for a month. At first his family covered their ears. On the day of the school concert, he played without a single mistake, and everyone clapped.

title: How Snakes Hear
text:
Snakes cannot hear sounds the way we do. They have no outer ears.

Instead, snakes feel movements in the ground. When a person walks nearby, a snake can feel the steps through its body.

title: The Market
text: On Saturday, Asha went to the market with her uncle. They bought onions, tomatoes and a big watermelon. Her uncle carried the watermelon home on his shoulder.

title: Lost Shoe
text: Kabir could not find his left shoe. He looked under the bed and behind the door. At last, he found it in the garden, next to the dog's bowl.

title: The School Trip
text:
Class 4 went on a trip to the zoo. They left school at eight o'clock in a yellow bus.

At the zoo, a guide called Mr Das showed them the lions. Then the children ate lunch under a big banyan tree.

title: Fixing the Fan
text:
The ceiling fan in the kitchen stopped working. Amma tried switching it off and on, but nothing happened.

The next morning an electrician came. He found a loose wire, fixed it in ten minutes, and the fan turned again.

title: Sports Day
text: Sports day was planned for Tuesday, but it rained all day. The teachers moved it to Thursday. On Thursday the sun was out, and Leela won the skipping race.

title: The Parcel
text: Grandpa posted a parcel to Riya on the first of the month. It was meant to arrive in three days. It was lost for a while and reached her on the tenth, two days before her birthday.

title: Ants
text: Ants live together in large groups. Some ants look for food. Some ants look after the young ones. Some ants build and guard the nest. Every ant has a job to do.

title: Rain Water
text: Our school has a big tank on the roof. When it rains, water runs from the roof into the tank. We use this water for the garden, so we do not waste tap water. Saving rain water is easy and useful.

title: The Paper Boat
text: After the rain, Sana made a paper boat. She put it in the stream by the road. The boat floated past the shop and under the little bridge. Sana ran beside it, laughing, all the way.

title: The Kind Shopkeeper
text: Vikram dropped his money on the way to the shop. When he got there, he had nothing to pay for the bread. The shopkeeper smiled and gave him the bread anyway. "Pay me tomorrow," she said.

title: Owls
text:
Owls are birds that hunt at night. They have large eyes that help them see in the dark.

Owls also have soft feathers on their wings. Because of these feathers, they can fly without making a sound, so the mice they hunt do not hear them coming.

title: Our Street
text:
Our street used to be full of litter. Plastic bags blew everywhere.

Last month, the families on the street started a cleaning group. Every Sunday they pick up litter, and they have put three new bins at the corner. Now the street is much cleaner.

title: The Lunch Box
text: Every morning, Tara's grandmother packs her lunch. She makes rotis, a little dal and some fruit. She always adds a small note that says, "Eat well!" Tara keeps every note in a box under her bed.

title: Busy Bees
text:
Bees are very important to farmers.

When a bee visits a flower, tiny grains of pollen stick to its body. The bee carries them to the next flower. This helps plants make fruit and seeds, so farmers get more crops.
